diagnosis.summary: Three services are affected by two concurrent faults lasting 4 minutes. Order-service is returning a 25% 5xx error rate with a p95 latency of 1030 ms, up from 130 ms baseline, while 150 dependency errors per minute are being recorded against payment-service. Request rates to both product-service and order-service are running approximately 3x their baselines, and payment-service p95 latency has risen from 110 ms to 1020 ms.
diagnosis.root_cause: A traffic surge across product-service and order-service, and a payment-service latency degradation, active at the same time, are the most likely concurrent root causes. Product-service request_rate rose first at 17:03:00, payment-service p95_latency_ms rose about 65 seconds later at 17:04:05, and order-service error_rate_5xx rose about 35 seconds after that at 17:04:40 (observed sequence from correlated timestamps).
evidence: Product-service request_rate rose from 15.0 rps to 44.8 rps, approximately 3x its baseline; order-service request_rate rose from 2.9 rps to 8.7 rps, also approximately 3x its baseline.
Payment-service p95 latency rose from 110 ms to 1020 ms, approximately 9.3x its baseline.
Order-service recorded 150 dependency errors per minute against payment-service, up from a baseline of 0.
Order-service error_rate_5xx rose from 0.0 to 0.25, meaning 25% of requests are now receiving 5xx responses.
Order-service p95 latency rose from 130 ms to 1030 ms, approximately 7.9x its baseline.
recommended_actions: Investigate payment-service Lambda logs and concurrency configuration immediately to address its p95 latency spike from 110 ms to 1020 ms, as this is directly reflected in order-service 5xx errors and dependency error counts.
Apply rate and burst limits on the API Gateway stage to protect the stack while the traffic surge, which has pushed product-service to 44.8 rps and order-service to 8.7 rps, is ongoing.
Check lambda_throttle_count on all services to determine whether the traffic surge is exhausting shared Lambda concurrency across the account.
After stabilizing payment-service, recheck order-service error_rate_5xx and dependency_error_count to confirm errors are clearing before making further changes.
Record the onset times from the observed sequence when filing the incident so each fault's timeline remains distinct and no signal is attributed to another.
